title: Ohio's 8th Congressional District election, 2026
description: Ohio's 8th Congressional District covers parts of Butler, Darke, Preble, Hamilton, and Miami counties in the southwestern part of the state. Incumbent Republican Warren Davidson, who has held the seat since winning a 2016 special election to succeed former Speaker John Boehner, is seeking a sixth full term. He faces Democratic nominee Vanessa Enoch, a business consultant and former journalist who has been the party's standard-bearer in this district for multiple election cycles. The district has been reliably Republican for decades and is widely considered a safe Republican seat, with Davidson having won previous general elections with roughly two-thirds of the vote.
polling_note: No independent public opinion polls were found for this race. Cook Political Report rated the district as 'Solidly Republican' before the May 2026 primary.

candidates.name: Warren Davidson
candidates.summary: Warren Davidson has served as the U.S. Representative for Ohio's 8th Congressional District since June 2016, when he won a special election to succeed former House Speaker John Boehner. A U.S. Army veteran (1988–2000) who served in the 75th Ranger Regiment and 101st Airborne Division, he is a member of the House Freedom Caucus and serves on the House Financial Services Committee. Before entering Congress, he owned and operated a manufacturing business, Integral Manufacturing, in Troy, Ohio.

candidates.name: Vanessa Enoch
candidates.summary: Vanessa Enoch is a public policy expert, business leader, and former award-winning journalist running as the Democratic nominee for Ohio's 8th Congressional District. She is the CEO and President of Cultural Impact, LLC, a management and technology consulting firm specializing in workforce transformation, and holds a Ph.D. in public policy from Union Institute & University. Enoch has been the Democratic nominee in this district in multiple prior cycles, including 2018, 2020, 2022, and 2024, and has focused her campaign on economic mobility, workforce development, healthcare access, and social equity.
